sme.journeyIntro: Your India entry brief, readiness check, matched partners and India entry team.

readiness.checkIntro: 16 questions on JETRO's six asks. Your weak areas become gaps that TrustFit fills with trusted Indian partners.
readiness.notAnswered: This SME hasn't answered the readiness check yet.
readiness.severityHelp: Severity = how far from ready, weighted by how much it matters for a {role}.
readiness.seeWho: See who in India can fill them →
readiness.coveredNote: Every company TrustFit recommends is already Trust-scored and verified.

bridge.answerFirst: Answer the {link} first: matches are ranked on your gaps.
bridge.rankingHelp: Match = 0.6 × Fit + 0.4 × gap coverage. Only trusted companies that fit your brief are ranked.
bridge.noneFits: No trusted company fits this brief yet.
bridge.noneCovers: No trusted company covers this gap yet.
bridge.excludedHelp: TrustFit never recommends a knock-out, a Red verdict, a competitor's partner or a company without enough verified data.

exclusion.insufficient: Not enough verified data for a score
exclusion.notAFit: Not a fit for your brief

bridge.ringHelp: The team stops growing at {target}% (coral mark) or when another member adds too little.
bridge.stillOpen: Still open: {gaps}. Plan these yourself or ask TrustFit for more partners.
bridge.matrixHelp: Darker = more of the gap covered. Each capability counts once, from the team's strongest member.

brief.saved: Saved. Fit and matches use the new brief.
brief.readinessSaveFailed: Could not save the readiness answers

problem.name: Enter your company name

brief.productsHint: Pick the products you will sell in India, or add your own tag.
brief.statesHint: Click once for primary (counts double), twice for secondary, again to clear.

brief.importanceHint: Pre-filled with the defaults for the role you need.
